Xu Shen's family had long been wealthy, but through his lack of restraint he squandered it all. He took his wife to seek refuge with a kinsman and died at Tongzhou.
伸家 is Xu Shen's family; naming him makes the subject of 不檢 and 卒 clear.

That cousin led several dozen servants of powerful households in the dead of night, falsely charged them with debt, and battered down the door.
勢家仆 means servants of powerful families, not "henchmen's servants".

There was also Lady Ye, wife of Jiang Hua of Songxi, and Lady Chen, wife of Ye's younger brother Huisheng; together with their fellow villagers they fled the Wokou to Changtan.
